text:
Miguel: Heads-up — we're seeing intermittent missing span.status in traces forwarded to Datadog tile from the runtime. Demo tomorrow, want to avoid surprises. Anyone else?
Priya: Can you paste an example payload?
Miguel: Here is a minimal example we see in staging where status is absent for some request paths:
```json
{
  "traceId": "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736",
  "spans": [
    {"id": "00f067aa0ba902b7", "name": "infer.request", "attributes": { "http.path": "/v1/embedding" }}
  ]
}
```
Miguel: Note there's no span.status at top-level span attributes for ~20% of traces from grpc frontends.
Dan: Hmm. Could be OTLP exporter dropping status when it's default/OK. Our exporter recently changed behavior. Which exporter version?
Miguel: Using redwood-trace-proxy v0.3.0 (deployed via marketplace staging).
Zoe: @Miguel thanks for calling out. From partner side we expect span.status present for error tagging so dashboards and alerts work. If it disappears our trace-based SLAs look off.
Sara: Demo ops ask: does this affect the Datadog tile's waterfall and error rates? If counts change we may have to adjust demo script.
Priya: Quick check: can you run this local collector flag to force include_status?
Dan: Try adding this to the exporter config in staging: 
```yaml
exporter:
  datadog:
    include_span_status: true
```
Dan: That flag forces mapping of status.code => span.status even when code==0.
Miguel: Trying now on staging. Also noticed a proxy path that strips otlp.headers for internal health checks — might be normalizing spans.
Miguel: log snippet from proxy: 
```
WARN 2026-03-15T14:02:12Z proxy: dropped header otlp-status for conn 10.0.2.4
```
Zoe: If the proxy normalizes health-check spans we can add heuristics on the tile to treat missing status as OK, but that's brittle. Better to fix at the source.
Sara: Agree. For the quick demo, can we have a dashboard tile that uses presence of error attribute + http.status_code >=500 as fallback?
Priya: That fallback is safe for demo. We'll patch dashboard query.
Miguel: Deployed exporter config change to staging now. PD: running trace replay to verify.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: redwood-trace-proxy v0.3.1 -> staging by Dan (CI #4256) :rocket:
Miguel: Replay results look promising — status present for previously broken traces. @Zoe can you validate on your side?
Zoe: Validated in partner staging. Waterfall shows status and error annotations. UI still has a small alignment issue on right-rail counts (off by 1) — filing an issue with screenshots.
Sara: Great. For release notes / marketplace listing copy: add a note "improved trace status mapping for OTLP consumers" and call out recommended exporter version v0.3.1.
Dan: I'll cut the patch release and add the config flag to helm chart.
Miguel: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Priya will update demo dashboard fallback query; Zoe will post the partner UI bug; Dan will promote to canary tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
Zoe: Posting issue: https://phabricator.internal/RW-obs-322 (screenshots attached)
Priya: Updating notebooks and demo scripts now.
Miguel: Closing loop — if anyone sees trace anomalies after canary ping here.
Sara: Thanks team! :clap:
